Subject: Re: RC1 uploaded to PAUSE, and indexing problems

Rafael Garcia-Suarez wrote: > 5.10.0 RC1 is out ! woohoo ! It's currently propagating to the > mirrors. It's bleadperl at change #32367. (*) Kudos to Jarkko for fixing g++ build, because it allowed us to detect a small bug when Perl is compiled with g++ and threads: $ ./Configure -des -Dusethreads -Dcc=g++ -Dprefix=/usr/local/perl/5.10.0-rc1 $ make all test [...] Failed 3 tests out of 1434, 99.79% okay.         ../lib/constant.t         op/mkdir.t         op/time.t $ ./perl harness ../lib/constant.t /lib/constant....NOK 33/97 #   Failed test at ../lib/constant.t line 113. #     '1' #         > #     '6' # Looks like you failed 1 test of 97. /lib/constant....dubious         Test returned status 1 (wstat 256, 0x100) DIED. FAILED test 33         Failed 1/97 tests, 98.97% okay The test being: lib/constant.t 109: use constant E2BIG => $! = 7; 110: cmp_ok E2BIG, '==', 7; 111: # This is something like "Arg list too long", but the actual message 112: # text may vary, so we can't test much better than this. 113: cmp_ok length(E2BIG), '>', 6; It appears that $! isn't dualvar as it should be: $ ./perl -Ilib -MDevel::Peek -le'$e=$!=7; Dump($!)' SV = PVMG(0x69be90) at 0x670360   REFCNT = 1   FLAGS = (GMG,SMG,pNOK)   IV = 7   NV = 7   PV = 0   MAGIC = 0x663d20     MG_VIRTUAL = &PL_vtbl_sv     MG_TYPE = PERL_MAGIC_sv(\\0)     MG_OBJ = 0x670348     MG_LEN = 1     MG_PTR = 0x674ae0 "!" I've advised Rafael about this bug on IRC. He can reproduce it and seems to understand the root of the problem: 18:30 <@rgs> if I redef Strerror to strerror in mg.c 18:30 <@rgs> after having undef'd strerror 18:30 <@rgs> all tests pass 18:30 <+purl> Time to write more tests! 18:30 <@rgs> glibc bug --  Sébastien Aperghis-Tramoni Close the world, txEn eht nepO.
